```yaml
name: GlobalLeaks Directory Refresh

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force_refresh:
        description: 'Force refresh even if no changes detected'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  refresh-globaleaks-directory:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests beautifulsoup4 lxml pandas pyyaml

      - name: Fetch and Normalize GlobalLeaks Data
        run: |
          python scripts/refresh_globaleaks.py \
            --source-url "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GlobalLeaks/instances/main/instances.json" \
            --output-dir "data/directory/globaleaks" \
            --normalize \
            --deduplicate \
            --validate-fields "url,name,country,contact,tor_url" \
            --force-refresh ${{ github.event.inputs.force_refresh == 'true' }}

      - name: Generate Directory JSON Payloads
        run: |
          python scripts/generate_directory_payloads.py \
            --input-dir "data/directory" \
            --output-file "static/directory/index.json" \
            --include-globaleaks

      - name: Update Tab Counts and Metadata
        run: |
          python scripts/update_directory_metadata.py \
            --input-file "static/directory/index.json" \
            --output-file "static/directory/metadata.json"

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add data/directory/globaleaks/ static/directory/
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "chore: refresh GlobalLeaks directory data [skip ci]"
          git push origin main
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Pull Request on Failure
        if: failure()
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: refresh GlobalLeaks directory data"
          title: "Automated GlobalLeaks Directory Refresh"
          body: |
            This PR contains the updated GlobalLeaks directory data.
            The automated refresh job failed to push directly, so this PR is created for review.
          branch: "chore/globaleaks-refresh"
          base: "main"
```
